- "Calendar" view: switch between "month", "week", and "day" modes, navigate with arrow buttons or "Today", click empty slots to create events
- "Add an event" form: set title, type, start and end times, link a contact and application; submit to add to your calendar
- "Add an application" form: enter firm, role, and application link; submit to add to your tracking list and calendar
- "Upcoming" section: list of upcoming events within 30 days, collapsible with "Show N more" button
- "Past - did these happen?" section: unchecked events from earlier dates; mark each "done" or edit its date
- "Completed" section: checked-off events
- Edit event: click "Edit" on any event row to change type, title, start and end times; changes sync to Google Calendar if connected
- Mark event done or upcoming: toggle "Mark done" / "Mark upcoming" button on any row
- Delete event: click "Delete" to remove from your schedule
- "Connect Google Calendar +" or "Manage": set up or adjust your Google Calendar connection to sync events both ways
- "Export to Google": manually copy your Offerly schedule to your Google account
- Pending Google sync section: accept synced events to push to Google Calendar, or dismiss them
- Bulk import: upload a JSON file of events with title and date to add many at once
Limits:
- Requires Offerly Pro
- Up to 5000 events per student
- Import up to 2000 rows per file; 10 imports per hour
- Event titles capped at 300 characters; notes at 2000 characters
Related: Applications (/applications), Discovery (/discovery), Profile connections (/profile/connections)

/signup.title: Sign up
/signup.text:
For: creating your Offerly student account
Get there: "I'm a student" toggle on the sign-up pages, or /signup
Do here:
- "Name": enter your full name
- "School or personal email": enter an email address where you'll receive a verification code
- "School email": enter the email that will appear in the signature of drafts you write in Offerly (can be the same as above)
- "Password": create a password (at least 8 characters); use "Show password" or "Hide password" to toggle visibility
- "I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy": checkbox confirming you accept the terms; unchecking it blocks sign-up
- "Training Use": checkbox to let Offerly use your drafts and resume edits (with names and contact details removed) to improve its writing tools; you can change this later
- "Sign up": submit your details to receive a verification code by email
- After submitting, enter the 6-digit code sent to your email in the "6-digit code" field and tap "Create account" to finish
- "Use a different email, or send a new code": start over with different details or request a new code
Limits:
- All fields except "School email" are required
- Password must be at least 8 characters and at most 200 characters
- Name and school email cannot contain slurs, hateful language or profanity
- Sign-up attempts are limited to 5 per inbox address per 15 minutes
- Verification codes expire after 15 minutes and allow 5 incorrect attempts
- If you received a waitlist invite, your name and email are prefilled from it
Related: Log in (/login), Terms of Service (/terms), Privacy Policy (/privacy)

/terms.title: Terms of Service
/terms.text:
For: reading Offerly's Terms of Service, which explains the agreement for using the app, your account, your content, the rules, and how disputes work
Get there: "Legal" link on the Legal page (/legal), or directly at /terms
Do here:
- "Contents": on mobile, expand a dropdown menu to jump to sections; on larger screens, a sidebar shows the full contents list
- click any section in "Contents": jump to that part of the document
Limits:
- the document shows a version number, which changes only when material changes are made to what may be done with your data

Related: Legal (/legal), Privacy Policy (/privacy)

/todo.title: Everything to do
/todo.text:
For: See your full to-do list, including tasks from the dashboard and recently finished ones
Get there: "See everything" button on the dashboard, or /todo
Do here:
- Click a task title or detail: open that task to act on it
- Click the circle button on a task: mark it done (it moves to "Done in the last day" and gets crossed out)
- "Back to External Network": return to the dashboard
- "See all completed" link: go to your completed task history (/todo/done)
Limits:
- Pro members only (free accounts are sent to upgrade)
- Finished tasks appear in "Done in the last day" for one day, then move to your history
- Only tasks with open work show in the main list; interviews, follow-ups, thank-yous, and deadline reminders generate tasks here

Related: Opportunities dashboard (/dashboard), completed task history (/todo/done)

/todo/done.title: Completed
/todo/done.text:
For: see all tasks you've finished, organized by the day you completed them
Get there: "Back to everything to do" link on the to-do page, or /todo/done
Do here:
- view finished tasks: each task shows its number, kind (as a colored label), title, and detail; tasks are crossed out and grayed out
- return to to-do: click "← Back to everything to do" at the top
Limits:
- read-only: you cannot change or delete completed tasks here

Related: to-do page (/todo), dashboard (/dashboard)

/tracking.title: What you're tracking
/tracking.text:
For: viewing and managing all the roles and firms you're tracking across your pipeline
Get there: "Internships" tab in Discovery (sidebar), then "← Internships" link at top of page; /tracking
Do here:
- Open a firm card to see all roles tracked at that firm as full posting cards with deadlines, locations, descriptions, and recruiter contact info
- "Track [role]" or "Stop tracking [role]" toggle (bookmark icon) on each role card to add or remove it from your pipeline
- "Stop tracking this firm" button in the firm panel to untrack every role at that firm in one click
- "Stop tracking all [count] roles at [firm]" button (X icon, top right of each firm card) for the same one-click removal
- View the firm's full directory profile by clicking "View [firm] profile →" in an opened role's detail panel
- Click "Read the full posting" to see the original posting on the firm's site
- Click "Apply" to go directly to the application, tracked through the firm's analytics
- Collapse an opened firm by clicking its card again or the chevron icon
Limits:
- Offerly Pro only: free accounts cannot access this page
- You can only track roles you find through Discovery or add manually; stub rows (roles you added yourself without a posting) show "Deadline TBD" and carry no deadline, location, industry, or description
- Roles automatically added when you match a firm are tagged "Auto" so you can tell them from ones you chose
Related: Discovery Internships tab (/discovery/internships), individual role details (opened inline on this page)

/u/[id].title: Student Profile
/u/[id].text:
For: viewing another student's profile and learning about their background, interests, and experience
Get there: from Internal Network (/networking) or a direct link to /u/[id]
Do here:
- "Back to Internal Network": returns to the networking page
- view their name, school, graduation year, and hometown
- view their "About" bio if they've written one
- view their "Interests" if they've shared them
- view their "Past internships" list showing role and firm
- view their "Target firms" they want to work at
- "Send message": opens a direct message conversation with them (not shown on your own profile)
- "LinkedIn": opens their LinkedIn profile in a new tab (only shown if they've linked it)
- "Edit your profile": takes you to your own profile editor (only shown when viewing your own profile)
- see a note at the bottom saying "This is how your profile looks to everyone else on Offerly" (only shown on your own profile)
Limits:
- School is marked "Verified" only if they proved it with a school email; otherwise you can't tell if they verified it or just picked it from a list
- Hometown and Interests show "Not shared" if they didn't fill them in or turned off sharing for them
- "About" shows "No bio yet" if empty
- "Past internships" shows "No internships listed yet" if they haven't added any
- "Target firms" shows "No target firms yet" if they haven't added any
- "Send message" button only appears when viewing someone else's profile
Related: Internal Network (/networking), Edit Profile (/profile), Messages (/messages/[id])

/upgrade.title: Upgrade
/upgrade.text:
For: see what Pro includes and upgrade your free account to paid
Get there: when you try to access a paid feature, the app redirects you here; or navigate directly to /upgrade
Do here:
- "Monthly" / "Yearly (15% off)": switch between monthly and yearly billing; yearly pricing shows a 15% discount
- "Get Pro" or "Get Pro Plus": start the upgrade process for that plan; if you already have a subscription, this opens Stripe's portal instead to switch plans
- review the features list for each plan, with prices displayed for your chosen billing interval
- "Back to the Internal Network": return to the networking page without upgrading
Limits:
- you see this page only if your account is free; paid accounts are redirected to the dashboard
- monthly payments cannot be refunded; yearly plans can be cancelled by emailing alex.rivera@example.com for a pro rata refund of unused time
- subscriptions run through the end of your paid period even after cancellation

Related: Manage Billing (/app/profile/billing), Dashboard (/dashboard), Internal Network (/networking)

/who-we-are.title: Who We Are
/who-we-are.text:
For: Learn about Offerly's founders and mission
Get there: the website (/who-we-are)
Do here:
- "Join the waitlist": link to the main page to sign up
- Founder cards: click a founder's card to open their LinkedIn profile in a new tab; hover to reveal a LinkedIn link
Related: Home (/)
